parsed_entries.requirement: The Central Government may prescribe security procedures and practices for the purposes of sections 14 and 15 of the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the organization has implemented security procedures and practices as prescribed by the Central Government.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to organizations subject to the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is tied to the Central Government's authority to prescribe security measures.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Controller of Certifying Authorities must maintain a public database containing the disclosure record of every Certifying Authority.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the organization maintains a publicly accessible database of Certifying Authority disclosure records.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities and the Controller of Certifying Authorities.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation requires transparency in the operations of Certifying Authorities.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Controller of Certifying Authorities must publish notice of suspension or revocation of a Certifying Authority in the database maintained by him.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the organization publishes notices of suspension or revocation in the public database.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities and the Controller of Certifying Authorities.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation ensures transparency in the status of Certifying Authorities.

parsed_entries.requirement: The database containing notices of suspension or revocation must be made available through a website accessible round the clock.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the organization provides 24/7 access to the database containing suspension or revocation notices.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities and the Controller of Certifying Authorities.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation ensures continuous public access to critical information.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Controller or authorized person may access computers and data if there is reasonable cause to suspect a contravention of the provisions of this Chapter.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the organization has access protocols for investigating potential contraventions of the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the Controller of Certifying Authorities and authorized personnel.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation outlines the authority for accessing data in the interest of law enforcement.
